question: how did resale prices compare to new construction in Mitte during high mortgage rates
search_query: Comparison of resale prices to new construction prices in Mitte during periods of high mortgage rates
answer:
During periods of high mortgage rates in Mitte, Berlin, resale prices were consistently lower than new construction prices. 

For example, in May 2020, the resale price was 7386 EUR/m² compared to a new construction price of 9112 EUR/m², with an average mortgage rate of 1.1% (source: May 2020 statistics). By January 2023, with a higher average mortgage rate of 3.85%, the resale price had increased to 9405 EUR/m², while the new construction price rose to 11698 EUR/m² (source: January 2023 statistics). 

This trend indicates that even as both resale and new construction prices increased over time, new construction remained more expensive than resale properties throughout the observed periods.
